crossRefs.note: Though this house is so high, yet everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss; and they will say, ‘Why has…
They burned God’s house, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem, and burned all its palaces with fire, and destroyed all…
Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid…
therefore I will do to the house which is called by my name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you…
Why have you prophesied in Yahweh’s name, saying, ‘This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be desolate…
The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things; for she has seen that the nations have entered into…
The Lord has cast off his altar. He has abhorred his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hand of…
Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain…
As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,
“As for these things which you see, the days will come, in which there will not be left here one stone on another that…

Behold, I will command,” says Yahweh, “and cause them to return to this city. They will fight against it, take it, and…
The Chaldeans will come again, and fight against this city. They will take it and burn it with fire.” ’
For though you had struck the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and only wounded men remained among…
The Chaldeans burned the king’s house, and the houses of the people, with fire, and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

but I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: He burned Yahweh’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, he burned with fire.
translations.bsb: He burned down the house of the LORD, the royal palace, and all the houses of Jerusalem—every significant building.
translations.kjv: And he burnt the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man's house burnt he with fire.
translations.asv: And he burnt the house of Jehovah, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, burnt he with fire.
